jobs.title: Corporate Communications Program Manager
jobs.description:
Become part of the excitement.

As a Corporate Communications Program Manager, you will be responsible for developing and implementing effective communication programs for public relations, social media and internal communications. You will build awareness, credibility and visibility for Graybar while protecting the Company’s reputation.

In this job you will:
- Develop and manage internal and external communication programs that reach target audiences using a diverse mix of communication tactics.
- Coordinate day-to-day management of media relations and social media activities that align with overall strategy and business goals.
- Oversee internal communication programs that support Graybar’s strategy.
- Create content to drive greater awareness around specific messages, themes or issues, or further engagement with specific audiences
- Increase visibility of the Company’s executives and subject matter experts (SMEs) through speaking and editorial opportunities.
- Manage participation in relevant industry awards programs.
- Participate in development of a crisis response plan; manage media during crisis.
- Research and recommend new technologies and channels that may enhance company communications.

What you bring to the table:
- 5 years experience required
- 6+ years experience in  communications, specifically within public relations and internal communications preferred
- 4 year degree in communications, journalism, business and/or liberal arts preferred
- Understanding of media needs and relationships
- General industry knowledge, as well as knowledge of key industry influencers
- Knowledge of internal communications and organizational change management principles
- Familiarity with social media management and measurement tools
- Message and story development skills
- Excellent oral and written communication skills
- Good analytical and problem solving skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, exercise good judgment, and deal with confidential information
- Detail oriented, thorough, and accurate
- Creative and innovative
- Ability to build relationships
- Some travel required

Compensation Details: The expected starting rate of pay for this position is $75,000 annually depending on experience. This position is also incentive eligible, based on specific and relevant business metrics.

jobs.title: Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.description:
Become part of the excitement.

As a  Manager - Financial Planning & Analysis, you will support and assist in advancing the Company’s strategic plans by providing insightful business analyses, financial impact estimates, and forecasts of existing trends in business processes, resource investments, and business units to evaluate progress toward long range goals and make recommendations for achieving those goals.

In this role you will:
- Prepare financial and business related research and analysis on existing processes, markets, and business units
- Analyze current and past trends in key performance indicators including all areas of revenue, cost of sales, expenses and resource investments
- Monitor performance indicators, highlighting trends and analyzing causes of unexpected variance
- Develop sophisticated modeling to forecast business trends.
- Assist with special financial and business related studies and cooperate with other departments in preparing analyses
- Compile and prepare reports, graphs and charts of research results
- Provide market intelligence, evaluate local markets, analyze current and potential financial metrics, and make recommendations
- Analyze, determine and recommend staffing levels for various markets
- Responsible for end-of-year budgets for the Income Statement

What you bring to the table:
- 5 years experience in data research, financial analysis, and forecasting
- 4 year degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting or related discipline
- Advanced mathematical and analytical skills
- Excellent oral and written communication skills
- Advanced problem solving skills
- Ability to analyze various data, model complex scenarios, and forecast trends
- Ability to think creatively and evaluate multiple analytic methods
- Ability to effectively articulate and present research results to others
- Ability to persuade and influence others
- Ability to work independently and objectively
- Ability to achieve highest standards of accuracy and precision
- Ability to manage time and research projects effectively
- Occasional to frequent travel required

Compensation Details: The expected starting rate of pay for this position is $105,000 annually, depending on experience. This position is also incentive eligible, based on specific and relevant business metrics.

jobs.title: Treasury Analyst
jobs.description:
Make a difference.

As a Treasury Analyst, you will perform detailed analysis and provide specialized reporting to senior management that will optimize financial planning and decision making.

In this role you will:
- Prepare and develop various non-recurring and recurring reports and forecasting models as assigned by the Assistant Treasurer, Vice President and Treasurer, or Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.
- Provide the Vice President and Treasurer with various specialized monthly, quarterly, and annual reports on the performance of the Company's accounts receivable portfolio.
- Perform analysis on financial decision-making opportunities such as rate of return, lease verses buy, capital budgeting, and lease internal rate of return.
- Responsible for preparation of the quarterly report that is presented to the Company's Finance Committee; audit final reports for accuracy and ensure deadlines are met.
- Recommend, develop, and maintain models that forecast the future financial performance of the Company.
- Provide independent valuations of acquisition candidates.
- Provide backup to other Treasury functions

What you bring to the table:
- Minimum 3 years of experience:  Must have excellent skills in spreadsheet and forecast computing including Excel, Visual Basic, and Access and demonstrated ability to understand and apply basic financial concepts
- 4+ years of experience preferred
- Four-year degree: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, or a closely related discipline; advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.
- Knowledge of financial practices and techniques
- Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques and how to apply them to the Company's proprietary models
- Understanding of how to apply basic to moderately complex financial concepts
- Ability to analyze and draw conclusions from large volumes of data
- Ability to perform a wide variety of moderately complex treasury activities
- Excellent skills in Excel
- Strong oral and written communication skills
- Ability to work under limited supervision and exercise good judgment
- Some travel required

Compensation Details: The expected starting rate of pay for this position is $67,919 annually, depending on experience. This position is also incentive eligible, based on specific and relevant business metrics.

jobs.title: Financial Manager
jobs.description:
Become part of the excitement.

As a Financial Manager, you will support profit center sales and profitability initiatives through the extension of customer credit and management of accounts receivable portfolios.

In this role you will:
- Establish creditworthiness of new and existing customers, authorize and monitor credit limits
- Manage accounts receivable portfolio of assigned profit centers
- Protect and enhance profit center profitability
- Establish and maintain customer relationships in support of both sales and credit management initiatives

What you bring to the table:
- Corporate finance, accounting, and/or financial reporting knowledge
- Analytical and decision making skills
- Communication, collaboration, and negotiation skills
- 3+ years experience required
- 4 year degree: Business Degree or equivalent experience; major in Finance required
- Ability to travel

Work Shift and Hours: Monday - Friday, standard business hours, in office
